name: Summer Mathematics Program for High School Students (University of Utah)
org: University of Utah Department of Mathematics
what_you_do: Students spend about three weeks on hard math problems and big ideas. The 2026 program focused on math and biology. Students earn three university credits.
who_can_apply: High school students ready to start Calculus. You do not need to have taken it. Students between junior and senior year are preferred. Costs are paid for US citizens, nationals and permanent residents.
pay_detail: Free in 2026 for US citizens, nationals and permanent residents. You earn 3 college credits (credit or no credit).
duration: June 16 to July 2 in 2026, Monday to Friday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was May 28, 2026. The page lists no 2027 dates.
how_to_apply: Email four items to the program contact on the program page: an application form, a personal statement, a recommendation form and your school transcripts. All four are needed. Picks are based on merit.
notes: This is not a live-in program. Students who live far away must arrange their own housing. You must be able to attend the whole program. The 2026 program was in person.
